form.title: New Mosh Connection
form.description: Open a roaming UTF-8 terminal. SSH is used only to start mosh-server; SSH tools are not available.
form.capability_hint: One connection opens one terminal. SFTP, IDE, port forwarding, and SSH reconnect are unavailable.
form.jump_route_hint: Jump hosts are used only for the SSH bootstrap. The Mosh UDP host and port must remain directly reachable from this device.
form.udp_port_hint: Leave blank to let mosh-server choose a UDP port.
form.invalid_udp_port: Enter a valid UDP port or ascending range

mosh_profiles.missing_credentials: This Mosh profile has no stored credentials
